reason: The posted daily cleaning log, shoes off and the cap on how many kids are in at once are exactly what I look for, and the free first visit lets me check it myself before paying. I'd probably do the free visit and one paid one, maybe with my moms group.
objection: It's a drive for us and gas adds up, so I'm not coming every week unless it's really as clean as they say. I'd also want to see reviews from other parents first.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the place spotless in person on the free visit and good reviews from other moms. If it looked crowded or sticky I'd drop it.
